title: Onboarding: plan dashes and enter steering
text: /yoke onboard surveys existing work, helps the operator write goals and a high-level plan ready for parallel dashes as strategy docs through /yoke strategize (CURRENT-PLAN, a named initiative, or several), and configures only what those first dashes need. A plan is never final: once it is defined enough to staff the first wave, onboarding enters the main-session flow. Onboarding files no items; it takes steering seats with /yoke steer naming those docs, which takes a seat per doc, vets and files each dash itself, asks only key decisions as decision requests, assigns its done test, flow and QA plan when filing with --strategy-doc, and staffs the first wave. Project activation remains an item reaching done.
